subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should memory roles become the durable public plugin/config taxonomy while compaction remains on its existing provider contract and the legacy memory key is migrated out of runtime?
rationale: Tests can validate an implementation, but they cannot decide whether five role names, per-agent overrides, a parallel compaction selector, and a steady-state compatibility alias are the permanent product and plugin API contract.

options.title: Narrow the canonical contract
options.body: Keep role ownership where it represents a distinct memory lifecycle, use Doctor-only migration for legacy `memory`, and retain `agents.defaults.compaction.provider` as the sole compaction selector.

options.title: Sponsor the full taxonomy
options.body: Approve all five roles and both compatibility selectors, with explicit precedence, deprecation, upgrade documentation, and focused cross-version tests.

options.title: Pause for the RFC
options.body: Hold this PR until the linked memory interoperability RFC establishes the permanent role and provider ownership model.

recommendation.title: Narrow the canonical contract
recommendation.body: Keep role ownership where it represents a distinct memory lifecycle, use Doctor-only migration for legacy `memory`, and retain `agents.defaults.compaction.provider` as the sole compaction selector.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent cross-cutting history in memory state, loader, artifact, and plugin behavior and were explicitly routed into this PR discussion.
